review_evidence: README identifies the source as a Lean 4 implementation of the Poseidon hash function and documents HashProfile, contexts, preimages and domains.

A complete scan of all 22 Lean files found 152 declaration-style lines. Poseidon/Hash.lean formalizes hash contexts, state, full/partial rounds, MDS linear layers, round constants and input validation; Poseidon/HashImpl.lean defines domain separation and the primary hash construction.

The repository also contains MDS/round-number/round-constant generation and concrete parameter profiles. These are reusable cryptographic definitions and constructions even without theorem declarations in this snapshot.
summary: Reviewed Poseidon.lean and retain its formal definition and implementation of the Poseidon hash construction and parameters.
